proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9917 maśaka explicitly gives Bengali maśā, Oriya masā, Assamese mah and Kashmiri moh(u) mosquito. The selected moṣa/moha/mesa series fits this mosquito family, preserving sibilant and h variation and vowels. Local IA transmission and any learned reinforcement remain unresolved. Exact response: mesa.
